camel_example: aliyun ecs DescribeInstancesFullStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status Running --NotBefore.End '2017-11-30T00:00:00Z' --PageSize 10 --EventType 'InstanceExpiration.Stop' --InstanceEventType.1 'SystemMaintenance.Reboot' --HealthStatus Initializing --EventPublishTime.End '2017-12-07T00:00:00Z' --EventId.1 'e-bp1hygp5b04o56l00000' --PageNumber 1 --EventPublishTime.Start '2017-11-30T00:00:00Z' --NotBefore.Start '2017-12-07T00:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceId.1 'i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000'
description_en: Queries the full status information of one or more ECS instances. The full status information includes the instance status and instance system event status. The instance status refers to the lifecycle status of the instance, and the instance system event refers to the health status of maintenance events
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstancesFullStatus查询一台或多台ECS实例的全状态信息。全状态信息包括实例状态和实例系统事件状态，其中，实例状态为实例的生命周期状态，实例系统事件为维护事件的健康状态
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-instances-full-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --status Running --health-status Initializing --event-type InstanceExpiration.Stop --not-before-start 2017-12-07T00:00:00Z --not-before-end 2017-11-30T00:00:00Z --event-publish-time-start 2017-11-30T00:00:00Z --event-publish-time-end 2017-12-07T00:00:00Z --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --event-id e-bp1hygp5b04o56l00000 --instance-event-type SystemMaintenance.Reboot --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstancesFullStatus

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The lifecycle status of the instance. Valid values: 
Starting: The instance is being started.
Running: The instance is running.
Stopped: The instance is stopped
parameters.help_zh:
指定实例的生命周期状态。取值范围： 
Starting：启动中。
Running：运行中。
Stopped：已停止
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The health status of the instance. Valid values: 

Impaired: The service is impaired. 
Warning: The instance performance may be degraded due to maintenance.
Maintaining: The instance is under maintenance.
Initializing: The instance is being initialized. 
InsufficientData: The data is insufficient. 
NotApplicable: Not applicable.

The values are case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh:
指定实例的健康状态。取值范围： 

Impaired：服务损坏。 
Warning：警告，实例性能可能因维护而降低。
Maintaining：维护中。
Initializing：初始化中。 
InsufficientData：数据不足。 
NotApplicable：不适用。

以上参数取值均区分大小写
parameters.name: health_status

parameters.help_en:
The type of a system event. The EventType parameter takes effect only when InstanceEventType.N is not specified. Valid values: 

SystemMaintenance.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to system maintenance. 
SystemFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to a system failure.
InstanceFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to an instance failure.
InstanceExpiration.Stop: The subscription instance is stopped due to expiration.
InstanceExpiration.Delete: The subscription instance is released due to expiration.
AccountUnbalanced.Stop: The pay-as-you-go instance is stopped due to an overdue payment.
AccountUnbalanced.Delete: The pay-as-you-go instance is released due to an overdue payment
parameters.help_zh:
一个事件的类型。EventType参数只在未指定InstanceEventType.N参数时有效。取值范围： 

SystemMaintenance.Reboot：因系统维护实例重启。 
SystemFailure.Reboot：因系统错误实例重启。
InstanceFailure.Reboot：因实例错误实例重启。
InstanceExpiration.Stop：因包年包月期限到期，实例停止。
InstanceExpiration.Delete：因包年包月期限到期，实例释放。
AccountUnbalanced.Stop：因账号欠费，按量付费实例停止。
AccountUnbalanced.Delete：因账号欠费，按量付费实例释放
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range during which the events are scheduled to execute. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询事件计划执行时间的开始时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: not_before_start

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range during which the events are scheduled to execute. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询事件计划执行时间的结束时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: not_before_end

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range during which the events are published. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询事件发布时间的开始时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: event_publish_time_start

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range during which the events are published. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询事件发布时间的结束时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: event_publish_time_end

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the results. Valid values: positive integers.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果的页码。取值范围：正整数

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果的分页大小。取值范围：1~100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs. You can specify up to 100 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID列表。可输入最大100个实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of event IDs. You can specify up to 100 event IDs
parameters.help_zh: 事件ID列表。可输入最多100个事件ID
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.help_en: The list of instance system event types. You can specify up to 30 instance event types
parameters.help_zh: 实例事件的类型列表。可输入最大30个实例事件的类型
parameters.name: instance_event_type

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
